chunks: 1882 - And Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
That he asked him about a man who feels cold: may he enter under a blanket with his wife while he is fasting? He said, "He should place a cloth between them."
And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān has narrated from him عليه السلام:
"A concession for the elderly man regarding physical closeness."

key_terms.أَهْلِهِ: his wife or household, here referring to his spouse
key_terms.الْمُبَاشَرَةِ: physical closeness or direct bodily contact
key_terms.ثَوْبًا: a cloth placed as a barrier

ai.seo_question: Can a fasting man share a blanket with his wife while fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling related to fasting and spousal closeness. It indicates that a fasting man who shares covering with his wife should place a barrier between them, and it also mentions a concession for an elderly man in such physical closeness.
